title: Sometimes the hardest battle is letting God reveal the lies you didn’t even know you were living in.
paragraphs:
Sometimes the hardest battle is letting God reveal the lies you didn’t even know you were living in.
Truth doesn’t just set you free — it exposes everything you thought you needed, everything you built your comfort on, everything that kept you small.

When God shines His light, deception shatters.
When Truth enters, darkness loses its power.
✨ Let Him break what was never meant to hold you. ✨
“And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” — John 8:32
